title: Exponential-polynomial summit bound
statement: For all natural numbers $a',A,B,b,e,b',C,k$, define $T(n)=b'2^{C(n+1)^k}\Bigl(b\bigl((n+C(n+1)^k+1)^e+a'(2(n+C(n+1)^k)+3)\bigl(2(n+C(n+1)^k)+3+A2^{B(2(n+C(n+1)^k)+3)}\bigr)\bigr)+(n+C(n+1)^k+1)^{k+1}\Bigr)$. Then $T$ is exponential-polynomial: there exist natural numbers $K,j$ such that $T(n)\leq 2^{K(n+1)^j}$ for every natural number $n$.
